title.zh: 每增加一个幂级数变量，维数增加1
title.en: Each power-series variable adds one to the dimension

given.zh: S 是 Noether 局部环；常数项映射 S⟦X⟧→S 的核为 (X)。
given.en: Let S be a Noetherian local ring. The constant-coefficient map S⟦X⟧→S has kernel (X).

claim.zh: dim S⟦X⟧=dim S+1；递归得到 dim ℂ⟦X₀,…,Xₙ₋₁⟧=n，特别是三元情形维数为3。
claim.en: dim S⟦X⟧=dim S+1. Iteration gives dim ℂ⟦X₀,…,Xₙ₋₁⟧=n, and in particular dimension 3 for three variables.

statement.zh: S⟦X⟧/(X)≅S，且 X∈m、X 不是零因子。
statement.en: S⟦X⟧/(X)≅S, with X∈m and X a non-zero-divisor.

reason.zh: 常数项映射满射，核为 (X)；X 的常数项为 0，所以不是单位。乘 X 只是把系数右移，因而不会把非零级数乘成零。
reason.en: The surjective constant map has kernel (X). Since X has zero constant term it is a nonunit. Multiplication by X shifts coefficients and cannot annihilate a nonzero series.

statement.zh: dim S⟦X⟧=dim(S⟦X⟧/(X))+1=dim S+1。
statement.en: dim S⟦X⟧=dim(S⟦X⟧/(X))+1=dim S+1.

reason.zh: 将 Noether 局部环中的非零因子商环维数定理应用于 X，再用上一行的商环同构。
reason.en: Apply the dimension theorem for quotienting a Noetherian local ring by a non-zero-divisor, then use the quotient isomorphism.

statement.zh: d₀=dimℂ=0，dₙ₊₁=dₙ+1 ⇒ d₃=3。
statement.en: d₀=dimℂ=0 and dₙ₊₁=dₙ+1 imply d₃=3.

reason.zh: finSuccEquiv 把 n+1 元形式幂级数写成 n 元环上的一元形式幂级数，逐次代入前一行。
reason.en: finSuccEquiv writes n+1-variable formal power series as one-variable series over the n-variable ring, allowing repeated application of the preceding formula.

title.zh: 变量生成的理想就是极大理想
title.en: The variables generate the maximal ideal

given.zh: 有限多个变量、系数域 k；幂级数环在变量生成的理想下已有进完备实例。
given.en: There are finitely many variables over a field k, and the power-series ring has an adic-completeness instance for the ideal generated by the variables.

claim.zh: m=(Xᵢ : i∈σ)，所以幂级数环关于其极大理想进完备；三元复系数环也满足这一性质。
claim.en: Its maximal ideal is m=(Xᵢ : i∈σ), so the ring is complete for its maximal ideal, in particular in the three-variable complex case.

statement.zh: 在 k[σ] 中，I=(Xᵢ)=ker(constantCoeff)，且 k[σ]/I≅k。
statement.en: In k[σ], I=(Xᵢ)=ker(constantCoeff), and k[σ]/I≅k.

reason.zh: 多项式常数项为 0 恰好表示每个单项式都含变量；常数多项式给出满射，所以商环就是系数域。
reason.en: A polynomial has zero constant coefficient exactly when its monomials all contain variables. Constants give surjectivity, identifying the quotient with the coefficient field.

statement.zh: k 是域 ⇒ I 极大；I 在 I-进完备化中的像仍极大。
statement.en: Since k is a field, I is maximal; its image in the I-adic completion remains maximal.

reason.zh: 这里使用有限变量使 I 有限生成，再调用完备化中的极大理想保持定理。
reason.en: Finitely many variables make I finitely generated, allowing the maximal-ideal theorem for the completion.

statement.zh: 经 k⟦σ⟧≅完成环 拉回，得到 m=(Xᵢ)，故关于 m 进完备。
statement.en: Transporting along k⟦σ⟧≅the completion gives m=(Xᵢ), hence m-adic completeness.

reason.zh: 拉回的变量理想已经极大；局部环只有一个极大理想。用此等式改写已有的变量理想进完备实例。
reason.en: The transported variable ideal is maximal, and the local ring has a unique maximal ideal. Rewrite the existing variable-ideal completeness instance by this equality.

title.zh: 每个剩余类都等于一个常数的剩余类
title.en: Every residue class is the class of a constant

given.zh: R=ℂ⟦X₀,…,Xₙ₋₁⟧，常数项映射满射到 ℂ，其核为 m。
given.en: Let R=ℂ⟦X₀,…,Xₙ₋₁⟧. The constant-coefficient map is onto ℂ and has kernel m.

claim.zh: 自然映射 ℂ→R/m 是双射。
claim.en: The natural map ℂ→R/m is bijective.

statement.zh: constantCoeff:R→ℂ 满射，且 ker(constantCoeff)=m。
statement.en: constantCoeff:R→ℂ is surjective and ker(constantCoeff)=m.

reason.zh: 每个 c∈ℂ 都由常数级数 C(c) 映到；满射到域的核在局部环中就是唯一极大理想。
reason.en: Every c∈ℂ is the image of the constant series C(c). The kernel of this surjection to a field is the unique maximal ideal of the local ring.

statement.zh: 对任意 f∈R，constantCoeff(f−C(f₀))=f₀−f₀=0。
statement.en: For every f∈R, constantCoeff(f−C(f₀))=f₀−f₀=0.

reason.zh: 因此 f−C(f₀)∈m，任意剩余类 [f] 都等于 [C(f₀)]，证明 ℂ→R/m 满射。
reason.en: Thus f−C(f₀)∈m and every residue class [f] equals [C(f₀)], proving surjectivity of ℂ→R/m.

statement.zh: ℂ→R/m 单射且满射，因此双射。
statement.en: The map ℂ→R/m is injective and surjective, hence bijective.

reason.zh: 单射性来自系数域到非零剩余域的保单位环同态；与刚得到的满射性配对。
reason.en: A unital ring map from the field ℂ to the nonzero residue field is injective. Pair this with the surjectivity just proved.

title.zh: 逐个取出几乎整幂级数的系数
title.en: Recover the coefficients of an almost-integral series

given.zh: S 是 Noether 整闭整环，K=Frac(S)；f∈K⟦X⟧ 对 S⟦X⟧ 几乎整。
given.en: Let S be a Noetherian integrally closed domain and K=Frac(S). Suppose f∈K⟦X⟧ is almost integral over S⟦X⟧.

claim.zh: f 的每个系数都来自 S，因此存在 a∈S⟦X⟧，其自然像等于 f。
claim.en: Every coefficient of f comes from S, so f is the image of some a∈S⟦X⟧.

statement.zh: 取 b≠0，使每个 n 都有 b fⁿ=qₙ∈S⟦X⟧；令 m=ord(b)、bₘ≠0。
statement.en: Choose b≠0 with b fⁿ=qₙ∈S⟦X⟧ for every n; put m=ord(b), so bₘ≠0.

reason.zh: 这正是几乎整性的统一分母条件；最低非零系数 bₘ 提供一个属于 S 的固定非零分母。
reason.en: This is the common-denominator condition for almost integrality. The first nonzero coefficient bₘ provides a fixed nonzero denominator in S.

statement.zh: 取 Xᵐ 系数：bₘ f₀ⁿ=(qₙ)ₘ∈S，故 f₀∈S。
statement.en: Taking the Xᵐ coefficient gives bₘ f₀ⁿ=(qₙ)ₘ∈S, hence f₀∈S.

reason.zh: b 在 m 以前的系数全为 0，使卷积只剩 bₘ f₀ⁿ。于是 f₀ 对 S 几乎整；Noether 性给出整性，S 整闭再使 f₀ 落回 S。
reason.en: All coefficients of b below m vanish, leaving only bₘ f₀ⁿ in the convolution. Thus f₀ is almost integral over S; Noetherianity makes it integral and integral closedness puts it in S.

statement.zh: 写 f−C(f₀)=Xg，则 Xg 仍对 S⟦X⟧ 几乎整。
statement.en: Write f−C(f₀)=Xg; then Xg is still almost integral over S⟦X⟧.

reason.zh: 几乎整元构成子环，减去基环中的常数级数保持几乎整性；常数项为零恰好允许除出一个 X。
reason.en: Almost-integral elements form a subring, so subtracting a constant series from the base ring preserves the property. Zero constant coefficient allows a factor X.

statement.zh: 若 b(Xg)ⁿ=qₙ，则 qₙ=Xⁿq′ₙ，消去 Xⁿ 得 b gⁿ=q′ₙ∈S⟦X⟧。
statement.en: If b(Xg)ⁿ=qₙ, then qₙ=Xⁿq′ₙ; cancelling Xⁿ gives b gⁿ=q′ₙ∈S⟦X⟧.

reason.zh: 等式使 qₙ 在次数 n 以下的系数全为零，所以 Xⁿ 在 S⟦X⟧ 中整除 qₙ。同一个非零 b 因此也证明 g 几乎整。
reason.en: The equality forces all qₙ coefficients below degree n to vanish, giving divisibility by Xⁿ within S⟦X⟧. The same nonzero b therefore witnesses almost integrality of g.

statement.zh: 反复移位得到 fⱼ∈S；令 a=ΣⱼfⱼXʲ∈S⟦X⟧，则 a 的像等于 f。
statement.en: Repeated shifts give fⱼ∈S; the series a=ΣⱼfⱼXʲ∈S⟦X⟧ maps to f.

reason.zh: 对系数编号归纳，每轮把所需系数移到常数项；最后逐系数相等重建整条形式幂级数。
reason.en: Induction on the coefficient index shifts each required coefficient to the constant term. Coefficientwise equality then reconstructs the entire formal series.

title.zh: 把分式域里的整元拉回幂级数环
title.en: Pull integral fraction-field elements back into the ring

given.zh: S 满足上一步假设；令 F=Frac(S⟦X⟧)、K=Frac(S)、B=K⟦X⟧、L=Frac(B)。取 x∈F 对 S⟦X⟧ 整。
given.en: Under the same hypotheses let F=Frac(S⟦X⟧), K=Frac(S), B=K⟦X⟧ and L=Frac(B). Let x∈F be integral over S⟦X⟧.

claim.zh: x 已来自 S⟦X⟧；因此 S⟦X⟧ 整闭。
claim.en: Then x comes from S⟦X⟧, proving that S⟦X⟧ is integrally closed.

statement.zh: 系数嵌入诱导单射 φ:Frac(S⟦X⟧)→Frac(K⟦X⟧)。
statement.en: Coefficient inclusion induces an injection φ:Frac(S⟦X⟧)→Frac(K⟦X⟧).

reason.zh: S→K 单射，因此级数逐系数映射单射；分式域的延拓仍为单射，可在最后用来拉回等式。
reason.en: S→K is injective, so the coefficientwise series map is injective. Its fraction-field extension remains injective and will recover the final equality.

statement.zh: x 对 S⟦X⟧ 整 ⇒ φ(x) 对 K⟦X⟧ 整 ⇒ φ(x)=f，f∈K⟦X⟧。
statement.en: If x is integral over S⟦X⟧, then φ(x) is integral over K⟦X⟧ and equals some f∈K⟦X⟧.

reason.zh: 把 x 的首一多项式关系沿 φ 映过去并扩大系数环；域系数的一元幂级数环整闭，故像已来自该环。
reason.en: Map the monic relation along φ and enlarge the coefficient ring. One-variable power series over a field are integrally closed, so the image is represented in that ring.

statement.zh: x 的统一分母沿 φ 传给 f ⇒ f 几乎整 ⇒ f 来自 a∈S⟦X⟧。
statement.en: Transport the common denominator of x along φ: f is almost integral, hence comes from a∈S⟦X⟧.

reason.zh: 整元具有几乎整性；将相应的每个幂等式映过去，就满足上一阶段的系数下降条件。
reason.en: An integral element is almost integral. Mapping its power relations supplies exactly the coefficient-descent hypotheses from the preceding step.

statement.zh: φ(x)=φ(a) 且 φ 单射 ⇒ x=a。
statement.en: φ(x)=φ(a) and injectivity of φ imply x=a.

reason.zh: 任取的分式域整元都来自原幂级数环，这正是 S⟦X⟧ 整闭的判定条件。
reason.en: Every integral element of its fraction field comes from the power-series ring itself, which is precisely the criterion for integral closedness.

title.zh: 选定 R=ℂ⟦X₀,X₁,X₂⟧，逐项交付性质
title.en: Choose R=ℂ⟦X₀,X₁,X₂⟧ and assemble its properties

given.zh: 维数、极大理想进完备性、剩余域双射以及一元整闭性的保持定理均已证明。
given.en: Dimension, maximal-ideal completeness, residue-field bijectivity and preservation of integral closedness under one power-series variable have been proved.

claim.zh: R=MvPowerSeries(Fin 3,ℂ) 满足目标中全部存在量词和三个最终性质。
claim.en: R=MvPowerSeries(Fin 3,ℂ) satisfies all the existentially quantified structures and all three final properties.

statement.zh: R₀=ℂ 整闭；Rₙ₊₁≅Rₙ⟦X⟧，所以 R₃ 整闭。
statement.en: R₀=ℂ is integrally closed, and Rₙ₊₁≅Rₙ⟦X⟧, so R₃ is integrally closed.

reason.zh: 对变量数归纳，每次使用上一阶段的一元整闭性结论；有限元幂级数环同构把结果传回 Rₙ₊₁。
reason.en: Induct on the number of variables, applying the one-variable result each time and transporting it through the finite-variable series equivalence.

statement.zh: 取 R=R₃=MvPowerSeries(Fin 3,ℂ)。
statement.en: Choose R=R₃=MvPowerSeries(Fin 3,ℂ).

reason.zh: 该环已有交换环、Noether、局部环与 ℂ-代数结构；系数域的无零因子性给出整环结构，加上上一行的整闭性。
reason.en: This ring already has commutative-ring, Noetherian, local-ring and ℂ-algebra structures. The coefficient field supplies the domain property, and the preceding line supplies integral closedness.

statement.zh: R 关于 m 进完备，dimR=3，且 ℂ→R/m 双射。
statement.en: R is m-adically complete, dimR=3, and ℂ→R/m is bijective.

reason.zh: 分别取前面三个独立支路在 n=3 时的结论，填入存在见证之后的三个合取目标，完成 candidate_ring_properties。
reason.en: Specialize the three independent property branches at n=3 and fill the three conjuncts following the existential witness, completing candidate_ring_properties.
